instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, model views, properties, families already available in the project, and built-in IFC export commands. Small storefront with curtain wall. Start from a blank Revit project. Model a one-storey storefront room with three standard walls and one curtain wall or storefront glazed wall along the front side. Add one floor slab, one room named Storefront, and one door. This task focuses on using a curtain wall from the Revit GUI. Create real Revit model elements rather than visual-only detail geometry. Use the Revit Room tool for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Revit's built-in IFC export. Use IFC4 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain IfcSpace rooms named Storefront; at least 1 building storeys, at least 3 wall elements, at least 1 slabs, at least 1 doors, at least 1 curtain walls. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, and harmless metadata may vary.
